verses.sa: स्वाद्वीं त्वा स्वादुना तीव्रां तीव्रेणामृताममृतेन। मधुमतीं मधुमता सृजामि सं सोमेन। सोमोऽस्यश्विभ्यां पच्यस्व सरस्वत्यै पच्यस्वेन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे पच्यस्व॥
verses.tr: svādvīṃ tvā svādunā tīvrāṃ tīvreṇāmṛtāmamṛtena madhumatīṃ madhumatā sṛjāmi saṃ somena somo'syaśvibhyāṃ pacyasva sarasvatyai pacyasvendrāya sutrāmṇe pacyasva
verses.en: SWEbf with the sweet, I sprinkle thee with Soma, %strong§ With the strong, the nectar With the nectar, The honey-sweet with what is sweet as honey. Soma art thou. Get dressed for the A? vins. Get dressed for Sarasvatt. Get dressed for Indra the Good Deliverer'..

verses.sa: परीतो षिञ्चता सुतं सोमो य उत्तमं हविः। दधन्वा यो नर्यो अप्स्वन्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः॥
verses.tr: parīto ṣiñcatā sutaṃ somo ya uttamaṃ haviḥ dadhanvā yo naryo apsvantarā suṣāva somamadribhiḥ
verses.en: Hence pour ye forth the flowing juice, Soma, best Sacrificial food. He who, man's friend, hath run Within the Waters% hath with the pressing-stones poured out the Soma.

verses.sa: वायोः पूतः पवित्रेण प्रत्यङ्क्सोमो अतिद्रुतः। इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा॥
verses.tr: vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa pratyaṅksomo atidrutaḥ indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā
verses.en: Purified by Vayu's strainer, Soma that has passed away for Ward is Indra's proper friend. Purified by V^yu's strainer'. Soma that has passed away/ backward is indra's proper' friends.

verses.sa: पुनाति ते परिस्रुतं सोमं सूर्यस्य दुहिता। वारेण शश्वता तना॥
verses.tr: punāti te parisrutaṃ somaṃ sūryasya duhitā vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā
verses.en: By means of this eternal sieve may Si&rya's Daughter' purify The Soma that flows forth from thee.

verses.sa: ब्रह्म क्षत्रं पवते तेज इन्द्रियं सुरया सोमः सुत आसुतो मदाय। शुक्रेण देव देवताः पिपृग्धि रसेनान्नं यजमानाय धेहि॥
verses.tr: brahma kṣatraṃ pavate teja indriyaṃ surayā somaḥ suta āsuto madāya śukreṇa deva devatāḥ pipṛgdhi rasenānnaṃ yajamānāya dhehi
verses.en: Soma, with Wine, pressed, filtered for the banquet, cleanses priest, noble, brilliancy and Vigour. God, With the Bright give Deities enjoyment: s give food with flavour to the Sacrificer.

verses.sa: कुविदङ्ग यवमन्तो यवं चिद्यथा दान्त्यनुपूर्वं वियूय। इहेहैषां कृणुहि भोजनानि ये बर्हिषो नम उक्तिं यजन्ति। उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यश्विभ्यां त्वा सरस्वत्यै त्वेन्द्राय त्वा सुत्राम्ण एष ते योनिस्तेजसे त्वा वीर्याय त्वा बलाय त्वा॥
verses.tr: kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo nama uktiṃ yajanti upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇa eṣa te yonistejase tvā vīryāya tvā balāya tvā
verses.en: What then? As men whose fields $are fall of barley, etc., as aa in X. Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee for the Asvin Pair. Thee for Saras. Thee for Indra the Good Deliverer. This is thy home. For splendour thee. Theft fo|r man's vigour. Thee for strength.

verses.sa: नाना हि वां देवहितं सदस्कृतं मा सं सृक्षाथां परमे व्योमन्। सुरा त्वमसि शुष्मिणी सोम एष मा मा हिंसीः स्वां योनिमाविशन्ती॥
verses.tr: nānā hi vāṃ devahitaṃ sadaskṛtaṃ mā saṃ sṛkṣāthāṃ parame vyoman surā tvamasi śuṣmiṇī soma eṣa mā mā hiṃsīḥ svāṃ yonimāviśantī
verses.en: For each of you is made a God-appointed place.; so grant to me a portion in the highest sphere. Surd the strong art thou. This here is Soma. ]Entering thine own place do me no mischief.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽस्याश्विनं तेजः सारस्वतं वीर्यमैन्द्रं बलम्। एष ते योनिर्मोदाय त्वा ऽऽनन्दाय त्वा महसे त्वा॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'syāśvinaṃ tejaḥ sārasvataṃ vīryamaindraṃ balam eṣa te yonirmodāya tvā ''nandāya tvā mahase tvā
verses.en: Takeii upon a base art tboi;. Splendour of Asvins, Saras? manly vigour, might of)[Indra. This is thy home. I take thee for enjoyment.. I take thee for delight, take thee for greatness.

verses.sa: तेजोऽसि तेजो मयि धेहि वीर्यमसि वीर्यं मयि धेहि बलमसि बलं मयि धेह्योजोऽस्योजो मयि धेहि मन्युरसि मन्युं मयि धेहि सहोऽसि सहो मयि धेहि॥
verses.tr: tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi vīryamasi vīryaṃ mayi dhehi balamasi balaṃ mayi dhehyojo'syojo mayi dhehi manyurasi manyuṃ mayi dhehi saho'si saho mayi dhehi
verses.en: Thou art lustre: give me lustre. Thou art manly vigour; give me manly vigour. Thou art strength: give me strength. Thou art energy: y give me energy. Thou art passion; Give me passion. Thou art conquer ing might: give me conquering might.

verses.sa: या व्याघ्रं विषूचिकोभौ वृकं च रक्षति। श्येनं पतत्रिणं सिंहं सेमं पात्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yā vyāghraṃ viṣūcikobhau vṛkaṃ ca rakṣati śyenaṃ patatriṇaṃ siṃhaṃ semaṃ pātvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: May she, Vjshpcbika, who guards these two, the tiger and the wolf, The e lion and the wipg^d hawk, may she guard this map from distress.

verses.sa: यदापिपेष मातरं पुत्रः प्रमुदितो धयन्। एतत्तदग्ने अनृणो भवाम्यहतौ पितरौ मया। सम्पृच स्थ सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्त विपृच स्थ वि मा पाप्मना पृङ्क्त॥
verses.tr: yadāpipeṣa mātaraṃ putraḥ pramudito dhayan etattadagne anṛṇo bhavāmyahatau pitarau mayā sampṛca stha saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅkta vipṛca stha vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅkta
verses.en: When, a delighted boy, I bruised my rs^j mother? as I sucked her breast, Free from my debt, O Agni, I become thereby. My Mj parents are by me unharmed. United are ye all: with bliss unite me. Parted &are ye, keep me apart from evil.

verses.sa: देवा यज्ञमतन्वत भेषजं भिषजाऽश्विना। वाचा सरस्वती भिषगिन्द्रायेन्द्रियाणि दधतः॥
verses.tr: devā yajñamatanvata bheṣajaṃ bhiṣajā'śvinā vācā sarasvatī bhiṣagindrāyendriyāṇi dadhataḥ
verses.en: .The Asvins, the Physicians, Gods, stretched out the healing sacrifice, Sarasvatt with speech was a Physician, all with heroic powers investing Indra.

verses.sa: दीक्षायै रूपं शष्पाणि प्रायणीयस्य तोक्मानि। क्रयस्य रूपं सोमस्य लाजाः सोमांशवो मधु॥
verses.tr: dīkṣāyai rūpaṃ śaṣpāṇi prāyaṇīyasya tokmāni krayasya rūpaṃ somasya lājāḥ somāṃśavo madhu
verses.en: Symbols of Diksha.1 are grass buds, of Prayaniya sprouts of corn, Of Soma purchasing fried grains are symbols, Soma shoots and meath.

verses.sa: आतिथ्यरूपं मासरं महावीरस्य नग्नहुः। रूपमुपसदामेतत्तिस्रो रात्रीः सुराऽऽसुता॥
verses.tr: ātithyarūpaṃ māsaraṃ mahāvīrasya nagnahuḥ rūpamupasadāmetattisro rātrīḥ surā''sutā
verses.en: Atirathas sign is M^sara, the Gharma's symbol Nagnahu. Three nights with SurA poured, this is the symbol of the Upasads.

verses.sa: सोमस्य रूपं क्रीतस्य परिस्रुत्परि षिच्यते। अश्विभ्यां दुग्धं भेषजमिन्द्रायैन्द्रं सरस्वत्या॥
verses.tr: somasya rūpaṃ krītasya parisrutpari ṣicyate aśvibhyāṃ dugdhaṃ bheṣajamindrāyaindraṃ sarasvatyā
verses.en: Emblem of purchased Soma is Parisrut, foaming drink effused: Indra's balm milked for Indra by the A$vins and Sarasvatt.

verses.sa: आसन्दी रूपं राजासन्द्यै वेद्यै कुम्भी सुराधानी। अन्तर उत्तरवेद्या रूपं कारोतरो भिषक्॥
verses.tr: āsandī rūpaṃ rājāsandyai vedyai kumbhī surādhānī antara uttaravedyā rūpaṃ kārotaro bhiṣak
verses.en: The Sacrifice r*s seat is the throne's symbol, the jar containing Sura of the Altar. The mid-space is the northern Altar's symbol: the cloth for filtering is the physician.

verses.sa: वेद्या वेदिः समाप्यते बर्हिषा बर्हिरिन्द्रियम्। यूपेन यूप आप्यते प्रणीतो अग्निरग्निना॥
verses.tr: vedyā vediḥ samāpyate barhiṣā barhirindriyam yūpena yūpa āpyate praṇīto agniragninā
verses.en: Altar by Altar is produced, power, holy grass by holy grass. The stake is by the stake obtained, by Agni Agni, carried forth.

verses.sa: हविर्धानं यदश्विनाऽऽग्नीध्रं यत्सरस्वती। इन्द्रायैन्द्रं सदस्कृतं पत्नीशालं गार्हपत्यः॥
verses.tr: havirdhānaṃ yadaśvinā''gnīdhraṃ yatsarasvatī indrāyaindraṃ sadaskṛtaṃ patnīśālaṃ gārhapatyaḥ
verses.en: The Asvins are the Soma store, Sarasvatl the sacred health. For Indra formed in Indra's seat, the Matrons' Hall, the house-lord's fire.

verses.sa: प्रैषेभिः प्रैषानाप्नोत्याप्रीभिराप्रीर्यज्ञस्य। प्रयाजेभिरनुयाजान् वषट्कारेभिराहुतीः॥
verses.tr: praiṣebhiḥ praiṣānāpnotyāprībhirāprīryajñasya prayājebhiranuyājān vaṣaṭkārebhirāhutīḥ
verses.en: Orders he gains by bj orders, by Apris Apris of sacrifice, Post-offerings by fore b -fore-offerings, and by calls of Vashat

verses.sa: पशुभिः पशूनाप्नोति पुरोडाशैर्हवींष्या। छन्दोभिः सामिधेनीर्याज्याभिर्वषट्कारान्॥
verses.tr: paśubhiḥ paśūnāpnoti puroḍāśairhavīṃṣyā chandobhiḥ sāmidhenīryājyābhirvaṣaṭkārān
verses.en: By victims he geins victims, by ground riee-eakes sacrificial food, By metres kindling-verses, and Vashat-calls by Inviting-prayers.

verses.sa: धानाः करम्भः सक्तवः परीवापः पयो दधि। सोमस्य रूपं हविष आमिक्षा वाजिनं मधु॥
verses.tr: dhānāḥ karambhaḥ saktavaḥ parīvāpaḥ payo dadhi somasya rūpaṃ haviṣa āmikṣā vājinaṃ madhu
verses.en: Grain roasted, gruel, barley-meal, grains of rice roasted, milk and curd Are types of Soma: mingled milk, sweet whey, of sacrificial food.

verses.sa: धानानां रूपं कुवलं परीवापस्य गोधूमाः। सक्तूनां रूपं बदरमुपवाकाः करम्भस्य॥
verses.tr: dhānānāṃ rūpaṃ kuvalaṃ parīvāpasya godhūmāḥ saktūnāṃ rūpaṃ badaramupavākāḥ karambhasya
verses.en: Type of parched corn is jujube-fruit; wheat of the roasted grains of rice; Jujube the type of barley-meal, and Indra-grains of gruel -groats.

verses.sa: पयसो रूपं यद्यवा दध्नो रूपं कर्कन्धूनि। सोमस्य रूपं वाजिनं सौम्यस्य रूपमामिक्षा॥
verses.tr: payaso rūpaṃ yadyavā dadhno rūpaṃ karkandhūni somasya rūpaṃ vājinaṃ saumyasya rūpamāmikṣā
verses.en: Symbol of milk are barley-grains, symbol of curd are jujube-fruits. Whey is the type of Soma, and milk-mixture type of Soma's pap.

verses.sa: आ श्रावयेति स्तोत्रियाः प्रत्याश्रावो अनुरूपः। यजेति धाय्यारूपं प्रगाथा येयजामहाः॥
verses.tr: ā śrāvayeti stotriyāḥ pratyāśrāvo anurūpaḥ yajeti dhāyyārūpaṃ pragāthā yeyajāmahāḥ
verses.en: The Strophe is the cry. Bid hear! I the answer is the antistrophe. Sacrifice! I is the Dh&yy^'s form, Prag&thas' the Yajilmahas.

verses.sa: अर्ध-ऋचैरुक्थानां रूपं पदैराप्नोति निविदः। प्रणवैः शस्त्राणां रूपं पयसा सोम आप्यते॥
verses.tr: ardha-ṛcairukthānāṃ rūpaṃ padairāpnoti nividaḥ praṇavaiḥ śastrāṇāṃ rūpaṃ payasā soma āpyate
verses.en: By verse -halves comes the Ukthas' type, Nivids by Padas he obtains. The type of $Sastras is obtained by Pranavas, Soma by milk.

verses.sa: अश्विभ्यां प्रातः सवनमिन्द्रेणैन्द्रं माध्यंन्दिनम्। वैश्वदेवं सरस्वत्या तृतीयमाप्तं सवनम्॥
verses.tr: aśvibhyāṃ prātaḥ savanamindreṇaindraṃ mādhyaṃndinam vaiśvadevaṃ sarasvatyā tṛtīyamāptaṃ savanam
verses.en: Gained by the Asvins is the morn's libation, Indra's libation of mid-day by Indra. Sarasvati obtains the third outpouring, the offering sacred to the Vi§ve Devas.

verses.sa: वायव्यैर्वायव्यान्याप्नोति सतेन द्रोणकलशम्। कुम्भीभ्यामम्भृणौ सुते स्थालीभि स्थालीराप्नोति॥
verses.tr: vāyavyairvāyavyānyāpnoti satena droṇakalaśam kumbhībhyāmambhṛṇau sute sthālībhi sthālīrāpnoti
verses.en: By Viyu cups he gains the cups of Vayu, and by the basket gains the vat for Soma. By the two jars -he gains two cleansing-vessels, and by the cooking-pot the pot for cooking.

verses.sa: यजुर्भिराप्यन्ते ग्रहा ग्रहै स्तोमाश्च विष्टुतीः। छन्दोभिरुक्थाशस्त्राणि साम्नावभृथ आप्यते॥
verses.tr: yajurbhirāpyante grahā grahai stomāśca viṣṭutīḥ chandobhirukthāśastrāṇi sāmnāvabhṛtha āpyate
verses.en: By sacrificial texts are gained the Grahas, and by the Grahas laud and -arrangements. By metres are obtained Ukthas and praise-songs, and by the Sima-: chant the Avabhritbia..

verses.sa: इडाभिर्भक्षानाप्नोति सूक्तवाकेनाशिषः। शंयुना पत्नीसंयाजान्त्समिष्टयजुषा संस्थाम्॥
verses.tr: iḍābhirbhakṣānāpnoti sūktavākenāśiṣaḥ śaṃyunā patnīsaṃyājāntsamiṣṭayajuṣā saṃsthām
verses.en: Draughts he obtains by pouring out libations, and wishes by the utterance.of praises,? By §Sainyu he obtains Patpisamyajas, and Consummation by Samishtayajus.

verses.sa: व्रतेन दीक्षामाप्नोति दीक्षयाऽऽप्नोति दक्षिणाम्। दक्षिणा श्रद्धामाप्नोति श्रद्धया सत्यमाप्यते॥
verses.tr: vratena dīkṣāmāpnoti dīkṣayā''pnoti dakṣiṇām dakṣiṇā śraddhāmāpnoti śraddhayā satyamāpyate
verses.en: He gains by vow of fasting Consecration, by Consecration gains the priestly guerdon). He gains by priestly guerdon faith; by faith comes know knowledge of the truth.

verses.sa: एतावद्रूपं यज्ञस्य यद्देवैर्ब्रह्मणा कृतम्। तदेतत्सर्वमाप्नोति यज्ञे सौत्रामणी सुते॥
verses.tr: etāvadrūpaṃ yajñasya yaddevairbrahmaṇā kṛtam tadetatsarvamāpnoti yajñe sautrāmaṇī sute
verses.en: So far the type of sacrifice was formed by Brahmi and the Gods. All this he gains, when juice is shed, in the Santiimani sacrifice.

verses.sa: सुरावन्तं बर्हिषदं सुवीरं यज्ञं हिन्वन्ति महिषा नमोभिः। दधानाः सोमं दिवि देवतासु मदेमेन्द्रँ यजमानाः स्वर्काः॥
verses.tr: surāvantaṃ barhiṣadaṃ suvīraṃ yajñaṃ hinvanti mahiṣā namobhiḥ dadhānāḥ somaṃ divi devatāsu mademendraṃ yajamānāḥ svarkāḥ
verses.en: The rite with} sacred grass, wine, store of heroes, the mighty ones speed on with adorations. >{May we, sweet-sieging sacrificers, setting Soma mid Gods in heaven, ye Joy to Indra.

verses.sa: यस्ते रसः सम्भृत ओषधीषु सोमस्य शुष्मः सुरया सुतस्य। तेन जिन्व यजमानं मदेन सरस्वतीमश्विनाविन्द्रमग्निम्॥
verses.tr: yaste rasaḥ sambhṛta oṣadhīṣu somasya śuṣmaḥ surayā sutasya tena jinva yajamānaṃ madena sarasvatīmaśvināvindramagnim
verses.en: All essence of thine own in plants collected, all strength of Soma when poured out with Sur—Therewith impel with joy the sacrifice, Sarasvat, the Asvins, Indra, Agni.

verses.sa: यमश्विना नमुचेरासुरादधि सरस्वत्यसुनोदिन्द्रियाय। इमं तं शुक्रं मधुमन्तमिन्दुं सोमं राजानमिह भक्षयामि॥
verses.tr: yamaśvinā namucerāsurādadhi sarasvatyasunodindriyāya imaṃ taṃ śukraṃ madhumantaminduṃ somaṃ rājānamiha bhakṣayāmi
verses.en: That which Sarasvati poured out for Indra, by Asvins brought from Namuchi the demon, This flowing drop, brilliant and full of sweetness, I drink and feed on here, the King, the Soma,

verses.sa: यदत्र रिप्तं रसिनः सुतस्य यदिन्द्रो अपिबच्छचीभिः। अहं तदस्य मनसा शिवेन सोमं राजानमिह भक्षयामि॥
verses.tr: yadatra riptaṃ rasinaḥ sutasya yadindro apibacchacībhiḥ ahaṃ tadasya manasā śivena somaṃ rājānamiha bhakṣayāmi
verses.en: Whatever portion of the savoury fluid is clinging here, what Indra drank with powers, That drop thereof with pure and holy spirit I drink and feed upon, the King, the Soma.

verses.sa: पितृभ्यः स्वधायिभ्यः स्वधा नमः पितामहेभ्यः स्वधायिभ्यः स्वधा नमः प्रपितामहेभ्यः स्वधायिभ्यः स्वधा नमः। अक्षन् पितरो ऽमीमदन्त पितरो ऽतीतृपन्त पितरः पितरः शुन्धध्वम्॥
verses.tr: pitṛbhyaḥ svadhāyibhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhāyibhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhāyibhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ akṣan pitaro 'mīmadanta pitaro 'tītṛpanta pitaraḥ pitaraḥ śundhadhvam
verses.en: To Fathers who claim Svadhi be Svadh& and homage! To Grandfathers who claim Svadh& be Svadha& and homage! To Great-grandfathers who claim Svadha. be Svadha aud homage! The Fathers have eaten. The Fathers have rejoiced. The Fathers have been satisfied. Fathers, be ye purified,

verses.sa: पुनन्तु मा पितरः सोम्यासः पुनन्तु मा पितामहाः पुनन्तु प्रपितामहाः। पवित्रेण शतायुषा। पुनन्तु मा पितामहाः पुनन्तु प्रपितामहाः। पवित्रेण शतायुषा विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नवै॥
verses.tr: punantu mā pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ punantu mā pitāmahāḥ punantu prapitāmahāḥ pavitreṇa śatāyuṣā punantu mā pitāmahāḥ punantu prapitāmahāḥ pavitreṇa śatāyuṣā viśvamāyurvyaśnavai
verses.en: Cleanse me the Fathers who enjoy Soma! I Grandfathers make me clean! May Great-grandfathers cleanse me with a sieve that brings a century. May my Grandfathers cleanse me, may my Great-grandfathers fathers make me clean. With sieve that brings a century may I obtain full length of life.

verses.sa: अग्न आयू ंषि पवस आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः। आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम्॥
verses.tr: agna āyū ṃṣi pavasa ā suvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ āre bādhasva ducchunām
verses.en: Agni, thou pourest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength. Drive thou misfortune far away.

verses.sa: पुनन्तु मा देवजनाः पुनन्तु मनसा धियः। पुनन्तु विश्वा भूतानि जातवेदः पुनीहि मा॥
verses.tr: punantu mā devajanāḥ punantu manasā dhiyaḥ punantu viśvā bhūtāni jātavedaḥ punīhi mā
verses.en: Cleanse me the companies of Gods! May thoughts with spirit make me clean. Cleanse me all things that be! I Do thou, O Jatavedas, make me clean.

verses.sa: पवित्रेण पुनीहि मा शुक्रेण देव दीद्यत्। अग्ने क्रत्वा क्रतूँ१ रनु॥
verses.tr: pavitreṇa punīhi mā śukreṇa deva dīdyat agne kratvā kratūṃ1 ranu
verses.en: Purify me, O«, Agni, God, refulgent with thy pure bright sieve, With powers according to thine own.

verses.sa: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिष्यग्ने विततमन्तरा। ब्रह्म तेन पुनातु मा॥
verses.tr: yatte pavitramarciṣyagne vitatamantarā brahma tena punātu mā
verses.en: O Agni, may the cleansing sieve, diffused through all thy fiery glow, Holy devotion, make me clean.

verses.sa: पवमानः सो अद्य नः पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः। यः पोता स पुनातु मा॥
verses.tr: pavamānaḥ so adya naḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ yaḥ potā sa punātu mā
verses.en: May Pavamana with his sieve, Guest of all tribes, cleanse us to-dav, He who is Cleanser make us clean.

verses.sa: उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च। मां पुनीहि विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca māṃ punīhi viśvataḥ
verses.en: Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power, Purify me on every side.

verses.sa: वैश्वदेवी पुनती देव्यागाद्यस्यामिमा बह्व्यस्तन्वो वीतपृष्ठाः। तया मदन्तः सधमादेषु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvadevī punatī devyāgādyasyāmimā bahvyastanvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ tayā madantaḥ sadhamādeṣu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Dear to all Gods hath come the cleansing Goddess, she who contains these many smooth-backed figures. Through her may we in sacrificial banquets taking our pleasure be the lords of riches.

verses.sa: ये समानाः समनसः पितरो यमराज्ये। तेषाँल्लोकः स्वधा नमो यज्ञो देवेषु कल्पताम्॥
verses.tr: ye samānāḥ samanasaḥ pitaro yamarājye teṣāṃllokaḥ svadhā namo yajño deveṣu kalpatām
verses.en: The Fathers who in Yama's realm are equal and unanimous—Their—world is Svaha, reverence. To Gods let sacrifice be paid.

verses.sa: ये समानाः समनसो जीवा जीवेषु मामकाः। तेषां श्रीर्मयि कल्पतामस्मिँल्लोके शतं समाः॥
verses.tr: ye samānāḥ samanaso jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ teṣāṃ śrīrmayi kalpatāmasmiṃlloke śataṃ samāḥ
verses.en: Equals, unanimous, my folk yet living among those who live—On me be set their glory \through a hundred years in this our world.

verses.sa: द्वे सृती अशृणवं पितॄणामहं देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम्। ताभ्यामिदं विश्वमेजत्समेति यदन्तरा पितरं मातरं च॥
verses.tr: dve sṛtī aśṛṇavaṃ pitṝṇāmahaṃ devānāmuta martyānām tābhyāmidaṃ viśvamejatsameti yadantarā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca
verses.en: I have heard mention of two several pathways, way of the Fathers, way of Gods and mortals. On the^ie two roads each moving creature travels, each thing between the Father and the Mother.

verses.sa: इदं हविः प्रजननं मे अस्तु दशवीरं सर्वगणं स्वस्तये। आत्मसनि प्रजासनि पशुसनि लोकसन्यभयसनि। अग्निः प्रजां बहुलां मे करोत्वन्नं पयो रेतो अस्मासु धत्त॥
verses.tr: idaṃ haviḥ prajananaṃ me astu daśavīraṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svastaye ātmasani prajāsani paśusani lokasanyabhayasani agniḥ prajāṃ bahulāṃ me karotvannaṃ payo reto asmāsu dhatta
verses.en: May this my sacrifice bring store of children, with ten, brave sons, fulbcompanied, for welfare—Life-winning, winning offspring, winning cattle, winning this world of ours and peace and safety.. May Agni make my progeny abundant. Do ye confer food, milk, and manly vigour.

verses.sa: उदीरतामवर उत्परास उन्मध्यमाः पितरः सोम्यासः। असुं य ईयुरवृका ऋतज्ञास्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु॥
verses.tr: udīratāmavara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ asuṃ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste no'vantu pitaro haveṣu
verses.en: May they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma. May Fathers who have gained the world of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.

verses.sa: अङ्गिरसो नः पितरो नवग्वा अथर्वाणो भृगवः सोम्यासः। तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम॥
verses.tr: aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsaḥ teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma
verses.en: Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas" Atharvans, Bhrigus, who deserve the Soma.. May these the holy look on us with favour: may we enjoy their gracious loving kindness.

verses.sa: ये नः पूर्वे पितरः सोम्यासोऽनूहिरे सोमपीथं वसिष्ठाः। तेभिर्यमः सरराणो हवींष्युशन्नुशद्भिः प्रतिकाममत्तु॥
verses.tr: ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso'nūhire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ tebhiryamaḥ sararāṇo havīṃṣyuśannuśadbhiḥ pratikāmamattu
verses.en: Fil Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma,, who cam, most noble, to our Soma, banquet—With these let Yama, yearning' with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.

verses.sa: त्वं सोम प्र चिकितो मनीषा त्वं रजिष्ठमनु नेषि पन्थाम्। तव प्रणीती पितरो न इन्दो देवेषु रत्नमभजन्त धीराः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma pra cikito manīṣā tvaṃ rajiṣṭhamanu neṣi panthām tava praṇītī pitaro na indo deveṣu ratnamabhajanta dhīrāḥ
verses.en: Thou,. Soma, art preeminent for wisdom; along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our prudent Fathers by thy wisdom, Soma,, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.

verses.sa: त्वया हि नः पितरः सोम पूर्वे कर्माणि चक्रुः पवमान धीराः। वन्वन्नवातः परिधीँ१ रपोर्णु वीरेभिरश्वैर्मघवा भवा नः॥
verses.tr: tvayā hi naḥ pitaraḥ soma pūrve karmāṇi cakruḥ pavamāna dhīrāḥ vanvannavātaḥ paridhīṃ1 raporṇu vīrebhiraśvairmaghavā bhavā naḥ
verses.en: For our sage Fathers, Soma Pavamdna, of old performed by thee their sacred duties. Fighting unvanquished; open the enclosures,: i enrich, us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.

verses.sa: त्वं सोम पितृभिः संविदानोऽनु द्यावापृथिवी आ ततन्थ। तस्मै त इन्दो हविषा विधेम वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāno'nu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven. So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become(. me the lords of riches.

verses.sa: बर्हिषदः पितर ऊत्य र्वागिमा वो हव्या चकृमा जुषध्वम्। त आ गतावसा शन्तमेनाथा नः शं योररपो दधात॥
verses.tr: barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūtya rvāgimā vo havyā cakṛmā juṣadhvam ta ā gatāvasā śantamenāthā naḥ śaṃ yorarapo dadhāta
verses.en: Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come help us: these offerings we have made for you; accept them. So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.

verses.sa: आऽहं पितॄन्त्सुविदत्राँ२ अवित्सि नपातं च विक्रमणं च विष्णोः। बर्हिषदो ये स्वधया सुतस्य भजन्त पित्वस्त इहागमिष्ठाः॥
verses.tr: ā'haṃ pitṝntsuvidatrāṃ2 avitsi napātaṃ ca vikramaṇaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ barhiṣado ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihāgamiṣṭhāḥ
verses.en: I have attained the gracious>minded Fathers, have gained a son and progeny from Vishnu. Th-y who enjoy pressed juices with oblation| seated on oil sacred grass, come oftenest hither.

verses.sa: उपहूताः पितरः सोम्यासो बर्हिष्येषु निधिषु प्रियेषु। त आ गमन्तु त इह श्रुवन्त्वधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान्॥
verses.tr: upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān
verses.en: May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen. may they be gracious unto us and bless us.

verses.sa: आ यन्तु नः पितरः सोम्यासोऽग्निष्वात्ताः पथिभिर्देवयानैः। अस्मिन् यज्ञे स्वधया मदन्तोऽधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान्॥
verses.tr: ā yantu naḥ pitaraḥ somyāso'gniṣvāttāḥ pathibhirdevayānaiḥ asmin yajñe svadhayā madanto'dhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān
verses.en: May they our Fathers whom the flames have tasted, worthy of Soma, come on God-ward pathways. Enjoying at this sacrifice their portion, may they be gracioiM unto us and bless us.

verses.sa: अग्निष्वात्ताः पितर एह गच्छत सदः-सदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः। अत्ता हवींषि प्रयतानि बर्हिष्यथा रयिं सर्ववीरं दधातन॥
verses.tr: agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥ-sadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ attā havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣyathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ dadhātana
verses.en: Fathers w^\om Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place. Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.

verses.sa: ये अग्निष्वात्ता ये अनग्निष्वात्ता मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयन्ते। तेभ्यः स्वराडसुनीतिमेतां यथावशं तन्वं कल्पयाति॥
verses.tr: ye agniṣvāttā ye anagniṣvāttā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante tebhyaḥ svarāḍasunītimetāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayāti
verses.en: For those who, burnt with fire or not cremated, joy in their portion in the midst of heaven, May the Self- Ruler form the world of spirits and this their body as his pleasure wills it.

verses.sa: अग्निष्वात्तानृतुमतो हवामहे नाराशंसे सोमपीथं य आशुः। ते नो विप्रासः सुहवा भवन्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: agniṣvāttānṛtumato havāmahe nārāśaṃse somapīthaṃ ya āśuḥ te no viprāsaḥ suhavā bhavantu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: We call the Agnishvattas, true to seasons, those who drank Soma in the N&rA^nisa. Prompt to give ear to us be they, the sages, and then let us be lords of wealth and treasure.

verses.sa: आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येमं यज्ञमभि गृणीत विश्वे। मा हिंसिष्ट पितरः केन चिन्नो यद्व आगः पुरुषता कराम॥
verses.tr: ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato niṣadyemaṃ yajñamabhi gṛṇīta viśve mā hiṃsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cinno yadva āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma
verses.en: Bowing the bended knee and seated southward, accept ye, all, this sacrifice with favour. Injure us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.

verses.sa: आसीनासो अरुणीनामुपस्थे रयिं धत्त दाशुषे मर्त्याय। पुत्रेभ्यः पितरस्तस्य वस्वः प्र यच्छत त इहोर्जं दधात॥
verses.tr: āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya putrebhyaḥ pitarastasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta
verses.en: Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings give riches to the man who brings oblation. Grant to his sons a portion of your treasure, and, present, give us energy, ye Fathers.

verses.sa: यमग्ने कव्यवाहन त्वं चिन्मन्यसे रयिम्। तन्नो गीर्भिः श्रवाय्यं देवत्रा पनया युजम्॥
verses.tr: yamagne kavyavāhana tvaṃ cinmanyase rayim tanno gīrbhiḥ śravāyyaṃ devatrā panayā yujam
verses.en: O Agni Kavyavahana, cause us to praise before the Gods, As our associate meet for lauds, wealth which e'en thou reputeat wealth.

verses.sa: यो अग्निः कव्यवाहनः पितॄन् यक्षदृतावृधः। प्रेदु हव्यानि वोचति देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्य आ॥
verses.tr: yo agniḥ kavyavāhanaḥ pitṝn yakṣadṛtāvṛdhaḥ predu havyāni vocati devebhyaśca pitṛbhya ā
verses.en: May Agni, Kavya-bearer, who hath worshipped Fathers true to Law, Announce to Gods and Fathers these our sacrificial offerings.

verses.sa: त्वमग्न ईडितः कव्यवाहनावाड्ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वी। प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन्नद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवींषि॥
verses.tr: tvamagna īḍitaḥ kavyavāhanāvāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvī prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi
verses.en: Thou. Agni Kavya bearer, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant, And gavest to the Fathers who did eat them with Svadhd. £at, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.

verses.sa: ये चेह पितरो ये च नेह याँश्च विद्म याँ२ उ च न प्रविद्म। त्वं वेत्थ यति ते जातवेदः स्वधाभिर्यज्ञँ सुकृतं जुषस्व॥
verses.tr: ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yāṃśca vidma yāṃ2 u ca na pravidma tvaṃ vettha yati te jātavedaḥ svadhābhiryajñaṃ sukṛtaṃ juṣasva
verses.en: Thou, Jatavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent, Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not. Accept the sacrifice arranged with portions.

verses.sa: इदं पितृभ्यो नमो अस्त्वद्य ये पूर्वासो य उपरास ईयुः। ये पार्थिवे रजस्या निषत्ता ये वा नूनं सुवृजनासु विक्षु॥
verses.tr: idaṃ pitṛbhyo namo astvadya ye pūrvāso ya uparāsa īyuḥ ye pārthive rajasyā niṣattā ye vā nūnaṃ suvṛjanāsu vikṣu
verses.en: Mow let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed. Those who have rested in the earthly region and those who dwell among the Mighty Kaces.

verses.sa: अधा यथा नः पितरः परासः प्रत्नासो अग्न ऋतमाशुषाणाः। शुचीदयन् दीधितिमुक्थशासः क्षामा भिन्दन्तो अरुणीरप व्रन्॥
verses.tr: adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ pratnāso agna ṛtamāśuṣāṇāḥ śucīdayan dīdhitimukthaśāsaḥ kṣāmā bhindanto aruṇīrapa vran
verses.en: As ia the days of old our ancient Fathers speeding the work of holy worship, Agni! Sought pure light and devotion, singing praises, they cleft the ground and made red Dawns apparent.

verses.sa: उशन्तस्त्वा नि धीमह्युशन्तः समिधीमहि। उशन्नुशत आ वह पितॄन् हविषे अत्तवे॥
verses.tr: uśantastvā ni dhīmahyuśantaḥ samidhīmahi uśannuśata ā vaha pitṝn haviṣe attave
verses.en: Right gladly do wte set thee down, right gladly make thee. burn and glow. Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to eat the food of sacrifice.

verses.sa: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः। विश्वा यदजय स्पृधः॥
verses.tr: apāṃ phenena namuceḥ śira indrodavartayaḥ viśvā yadajaya spṛdhaḥ
verses.en: Indra, v(ith waters' foam didst thou wrench off the head of Namuchi, Subduing all contending hosts.

verses.sa: सोमो राजामृतं सुत ऋजीषेणाजहान्मृत्युम्। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानं शुक्रमन्धस इन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु॥
verses.tr: somo rājāmṛtaṃ suta ṛjīṣeṇājahānmṛtyum ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.en: King Soma, pressed, the Dritik of Life, left Death behind with Soma-dregs. By Law came truth and Indra-power, the pure bright drinking-off of juice. The power of Indra was this sweet immortal milk.

verses.sa: अद्भ्यः क्षीरं व्यपिबत् क्रुङ्ङाङ्गिरसो धिया। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानं शुक्रमन्धस इन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु॥
verses.tr: adbhyaḥ kṣīraṃ vyapibat kruṅṅāṅgiraso dhiyā ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.en: Vhe Snipe of Angiras by thought from out the waters drank up milk. By Law came truth, etc., as in.

verses.sa: सोममद्भ्यो व्यपिबच्छन्दसा हंसः शुचिषत्। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानं शुक्रमन्धस इन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु॥
verses.tr: somamadbhyo vyapibacchandasā haṃsaḥ śuciṣat ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.en: The Hamsa throned in light drank up by metre Soma from the floods. By Law, etc.

verses.sa: अन्नात्परिस्रुतो रसं ब्रह्मणा व्यपिबत् क्षत्रं पयः सोमं प्रजापतिः। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानं शुक्रमन्धस इन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु॥
verses.tr: annātparisruto rasaṃ brahmaṇā vyapibat kṣatraṃ payaḥ somaṃ prajāpatiḥ ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.en: Prajapati by Brahma drank the essence from the foaming food, the princely power, milk, Soma juice. By Law, etc.

verses.sa: रेतो मूत्रं वि जहाति योनिं प्रविशदिन्द्रयिम्। गर्भो जरायुणाऽऽवृत उल्बं जहाति जन्मना। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानं शुक्रमन्धस इन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु॥
verses.tr: reto mūtraṃ vi jahāti yoniṃ praviśadindrayim garbho jarāyuṇā''vṛta ulbaṃ jahāti janmanā ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.en: The generative part enters the yoni: it leaves aside the reias and the m^tra. The CAul-in vested embryo leaves by its birth the covering folds. By Law, etc.

verses.sa: दृष्ट्वा रूपे व्याकरोत् सत्यानृते प्रजापतिः। अश्रद्धामनृतेऽदधाच्छ्रद्धां सत्ये प्रजापतिः। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानं शुक्रमन्धस इन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु॥
verses.tr: dṛṣṭvā rūpe vyākarot satyānṛte prajāpatiḥ aśraddhāmanṛte'dadhācchraddhāṃ satye prajāpatiḥ ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.en: Viewing both forms Prajipati gave truth and falsehood different shapes. PrajApati assigned the lack of faith to falsehood, faith to to truth. By Law, etc.

verses.sa: वेदेन रूपे व्यपिबत् सुतासुतौ प्रजापतिः। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानं शुक्रमन्धस इन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु॥
verses.tr: vedena rūpe vyapibat sutāsutau prajāpatiḥ ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.en: By holy lore Prajapati drank up both forms, pressed and unpressed. By Law, etc.

verses.sa: दृष्ट्वा परिस्रुतो रसं शुक्रेण शुक्रं व्यपिबत् पयः सोमं प्रजापतिः। ऋतेन सत्यमिन्द्रियं विपानं शुक्रमन्धस इन्द्रस्येन्द्रियमिदं पयोऽमृतं मधु॥
verses.tr: dṛṣṭvā parisruto rasaṃ śukreṇa śukraṃ vyapibat payaḥ somaṃ prajāpatiḥ ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu
verses.en: Seeing the foaming liquor's sap, PrajApati with the bright drank out the bright, the milk, the Soma juice. By Law, etc.

verses.sa: सीसेन तन्त्रं मनसा मनीषिण ऊर्णासूत्रेण कवयो वयन्ति। अश्विना यज्ञं सविता सरस्वतीन्द्रस्य रूपं वरुणो भिषज्यन्॥
verses.tr: sīsena tantraṃ manasā manīṣiṇa ūrṇāsūtreṇa kavayo vayanti aśvinā yajñaṃ savitā sarasvatīndrasya rūpaṃ varuṇo bhiṣajyan
verses.en: Wise, with mind, lead, and thread of wool the sages twine an amulet. Saras, vat t, Savitar, Varuna, the Asvins span sacrifice and healed his form for Indra.

verses.sa: तदस्य रूपममृतं शचीभिस्तस्रो दधुर्देवताः संरराणाः। लोमानि शष्पैर्बहुधा न तोक्मभिस्त्वगस्य मांसमभवन्न लाजाः॥
verses.tr: tadasya rūpamamṛtaṃ śacībhistasro dadhurdevatāḥ saṃrarāṇāḥ lomāni śaṣpairbahudhā na tokmabhistvagasya māṃsamabhavanna lājāḥ
verses.en: This his immortal shape with mighty powers three Deities bestowing gifts compounded. His hair they made with sprouts of grass and barley, and roasted grain with skin and flesh supplied him.

verses.sa: तदश्विना भिषजा रुद्रवर्तनी सरस्वती वयति पेशो अन्तरम्। अस्थि मज्जानं मासरैः कारोतरेण दधतो गवां त्वचि॥
verses.tr: tadaśvinā bhiṣajā rudravartanī sarasvatī vayati peśo antaram asthi majjānaṃ māsaraiḥ kārotareṇa dadhato gavāṃ tvaci
verses.en: His inner shape Sarasvati arranges and, borne on bright ])paths, the Physician Asvins: With Masara and sieve his bone and marrow, as on the Oxen's hide they lay the liquor.

verses.sa: सरस्वती मनसा पेशलं वसु नासत्याभ्यां वयति दर्शतं वपुः। रसं परिस्रुता न रोहितं नग्नहुर्धीरस्तसरं न वेम॥
verses.tr: sarasvatī manasā peśalaṃ vasu nāsatyābhyāṃ vayati darśataṃ vapuḥ rasaṃ parisrutā na rohitaṃ nagnahurdhīrastasaraṃ na vema
verses.en: By thought Sarasvat! with both NIsatyas forms lovely treasure and a be beauteous body. Like shuttle through the loom the steady ferment mixes the red juice with the fo foaming spirit.

verses.sa: पयसा शुक्रममृतं जनित्रं सुरया मूत्राज्जनयन्त रेतः। अपामतिं दुर्मतिं बाधमाना ऊवध्यं वातं सब्वं तदारात्॥
verses.tr: payasā śukramamṛtaṃ janitraṃ surayā mūtrājjanayanta retaḥ apāmatiṃ durmatiṃ bādhamānā ūvadhyaṃ vātaṃ sabvaṃ tadārāt
verses.en: By milk they generated bright immortal, productive seed, by Sura seed from urine, Chasing afar folly and ill intention, crude food and wind and meat that load^s the stomach.

verses.sa: इन्द्रः सुत्रामा हृदयेन सत्यं पुरोडाशेन सविता जजान। यकृत् क्लोमानं वरुणो भिषज्यन् मतस्ने वायव्यैर्न मिनाति पित्तम्॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sutrāmā hṛdayena satyaṃ puroḍāśena savitā jajāna yakṛt klomānaṃ varuṇo bhiṣajyan matasne vāyavyairna mināti pittam
verses.en: Heart with his heart Indra Good Guardian gendered: with rice-cake Savitar gave truth its being. Varun, doctoring the lungs and liver, forms, as with VAyu cups, the gall an I kidneys.

verses.sa: आन्त्राणि स्थालीर्मधु पिन्वमाना गुदाः पात्राणि सुदुघा न धेनुः। श्येनस्य पत्रं न प्लीहा शचीभिरासन्दी नाभिरुदरं न माता॥
verses.tr: āntrāṇi sthālīrmadhu pinvamānā gudāḥ pātrāṇi sudughā na dhenuḥ śyenasya patraṃ na plīhā śacībhirāsandī nābhirudaraṃ na mātā
verses.en: Cooking-pots pouring honey were the entrails: like a well-milking cow the pins were bowels. A hawk's wing was the spleen: through mighty powers the stool as mother was navel and belly.

verses.sa: कुम्भो वनिष्ठुर्जनिता शचीभिर्यस्मिन्नग्रे योन्यां गर्भो अन्तः। प्लाशिर्व्यक्तः शतधार उत्सो दुहे न कुम्भी स्वधां पितृभ्यः॥
verses.tr: kumbho vaniṣṭhurjanitā śacībhiryasminnagre yonyāṃ garbho antaḥ plāśirvyaktaḥ śatadhāra utso duhe na kumbhī svadhāṃ pitṛbhyaḥ
verses.en: The pitcher was the father of the rectum by powers, the womb which first contained the infant. Plain was the hundred-streaming fount as penis: the jar poured forth libations to the Father.

verses.sa: मुखं सदस्य शिर इत् सतेन जिह्वा पवित्रमश्विनासन्त्सरस्वती। चप्पं न पायुर्भिषगस्य वालो वस्तिर्न शेपो हरसा तरस्वी॥
verses.tr: mukhaṃ sadasya śira it satena jihvā pavitramaśvināsantsarasvatī cappaṃ na pāyurbhiṣagasya vālo vastirna śepo harasā tarasvī
verses.en: His face the basket, thence his head; the strainer his tongue, his mouth Sarasvati and Asvins. The Ch Chapya was his rump, his leech the filter, the bladder was his penis keen with ardour.

verses.sa: अश्विभ्यां चक्षुरमृतं ग्रहाभ्यां छागेन तेजो हविषा शृतेन। पक्ष्माणि गोधूमैः कुवलैरुतानि पेशो न शुक्रमसितं वसाते॥
verses.tr: aśvibhyāṃ cakṣuramṛtaṃ grahābhyāṃ chāgena tejo haviṣā śṛtena pakṣmāṇi godhūmaiḥ kuvalairutāni peśo na śukramasitaṃ vasāte
verses.en: Asvins w with both cups made his eye immortal, the goat and CO cooked oblation gave it keenness. With wheat eyelashes and with jujube eyebrows they clothe as 'twere a black and brilliant figure.

verses.sa: अविर्न मेषो नसि वीर्याय प्राणस्य पन्था अमृतो ग्रहाभ्याम्। सरस्वत्युपवाकैर्व्यानं नस्यानि बर्हिर्बदरैर्जजान॥
verses.tr: avirna meṣo nasi vīryāya prāṇasya panthā amṛto grahābhyām sarasvatyupavākairvyānaṃ nasyāni barhirbadarairjajāna
verses.en: The sheep, the ram to give his nostril vigour, the immortal path of breath by both libations. By Indra-grains and sacrificial jujubes Sarasvatt produced through-breath and nose hairs.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य रूपमृषभो बलाय कर्णाभ्यां श्रोत्रममृतं ग्रहाभ्याम्। यवा न बर्हिर्भ्रुवि केसराणि कर्कन्धु जज्ञे मधु सारघं मुखात्॥
verses.tr: indrasya rūpamṛṣabho balāya karṇābhyāṃ śrotramamṛtaṃ grahābhyām yavā na barhirbhruvi kesarāṇi karkandhu jajñe madhu sāraghaṃ mukhāt
verses.en: The bull for strength made Indra's form: the immortal hearing for both his ears by two libations. Barley and sacred grass composed his eyebrows: from his mouth came the jujube and aud sweet honey.

verses.sa: आत्मन्नुपस्थे न वृकस्य लोम मुखे श्मश्रूणि न व्याघ्रलोम। केशा न शीर्षन्यशसे श्रियै शिखा सिंहस्य लोम त्विषिरिन्द्रियाणि॥
verses.tr: ātmannupasthe na vṛkasya loma mukhe śmaśrūṇi na vyāghraloma keśā na śīrṣanyaśase śriyai śikhā siṃhasya loma tviṣirindriyāṇi
verses.en: Hair of the wolf was on his waist and body: the beard upon his face was hair of tigers. Lion's hair were his locks, for fame and beauty, worn on his head, his crest and sheen and vigour.

verses.sa: अङ्गान्यात्मन् भिषजा तदश्विनात्मानमङ्गैः समधात् सरस्वती। इन्द्रस्य रूपं शतमानमायुश्चन्द्रेण ज्योतिरमृतं दधानाः॥
verses.tr: aṅgānyātman bhiṣajā tadaśvinātmānamaṅgaiḥ samadhāt sarasvatī indrasya rūpaṃ śatamānamāyuścandreṇa jyotiramṛtaṃ dadhānāḥ
verses.en: Tie The Asvins, Leeches, joined his limbs and body, Sarasvati! put limbs and frame together, Giving the form and? vital power of Indra, hundredfold, deathless and delightful lustre.

verses.sa: सरस्वती योन्यां गर्भमन्तरश्विभ्यां पत्नी सुकृतं बिभर्ति। अपां रसेन वरुणो न साम्नेन्द्रं श्रियै जनयन्नप्सु राजा॥
verses.tr: sarasvatī yonyāṃ garbhamantaraśvibhyāṃ patnī sukṛtaṃ bibharti apāṃ rasena varuṇo na sāmnendraṃ śriyai janayannapsu rājā
verses.en: Sarasvati, as Consort of the Asvins, bears in her womb the nobly-fashioned Infant. King Varuna with waters' wealthy essence begetting Indra in the floods for glory.

verses.sa: तेजः पशूनां हविरिन्द्रियावत् परिस्रुता पयसा सारघं मधु। अश्विभ्यां दुग्धं भिषजा सरस्वत्या सुतासुताभ्याममृतः सोम इन्दुः॥
verses.tr: tejaḥ paśūnāṃ havirindriyāvat parisrutā payasā sāraghaṃ madhu aśvibhyāṃ dugdhaṃ bhiṣajā sarasvatyā sutāsutābhyāmamṛtaḥ soma induḥ
verses.en: Splendour of victims, powerful oblation, honey and meath with milk and foaming liquor, Healing Sarasvati! effused, and A>vins; from pressed and unpressed Soma, deathless Indu.
